warnings: LAST SHEET OF THE STRUCTURAL SET (S-17 of 17). It continues S-16 with six more SP plank details, and carries the same title block text as S-16 -- the two sheets are only distinguishable by their sheet code and their contents.

*** ONE DETAIL CHANGES THE BEARING RULE. *** 'บริเวณรอยตัดขาดหรือริม' states the minimum seating as 'ระยะไม่น้อยกว่า 1/2 ความกว้างคาน' -- half the beam width -- instead of the flat 'ไม่น้อยกว่า 0.05 ม.' used everywhere else. On a 0.20 m beam that is 0.10 m, double the general minimum. Recorded as a rule, not as a number, since it depends on the beam.

TWO DETAILS COVER PLANKS WITH NO BEAM UNDER THEM ('เสาหรือคานที่ไม่มีที่รองรับ'), and they are different solutions, not variants: one cantilevers a short cast-in-place nib off the column with 2Ø12 anchored in ('ฝังเข้าเสา') and a printed limit of ไม่เกิน 0.60 ม.; the other uses a diagonal haunch with 2Ø9. Both share the same title, so they must be told apart by their geometry.

'ขยายยกขอบคาน' GIVES NO HEIGHT -- only the 0.10 m thickness and one Ø9 bar, with the height deferred as 'ระยะตามแบบสถาปัตย์'. Flagged height_deferred_to_architectural rather than scaled off the drawing.
The level-change detail ('บริเวณต่างระดับ') likewise does not dimension the step between the two SP floors; flagged step_height_not_dimensioned.
Tie-bar size tracks the beam depth across both sheets: 1+1Ø6 on the 0.30 m beams, 1+1Ø9 on the 0.40 m beams. The เสริมพิเศษ topping mesh stays Ø6@0.20 running 0.70 m each side of a joint throughout.
